prompt_md: What's the fewest straight cuts that divide a round cake into 8 equal pieces? You can't move or stack the pieces between cuts.
prompt_short: Fewest straight cuts to split a round cake into 8 equal pieces?
hint_md: Who says every cut has to go straight down?
explain_intuition_md: Two cuts straight down through the center make 4 equal wedges. One flat cut through the middle of the cake's height then splits all 4 into 8. Slicing it like a pizza needs 4 cuts.
explain_math_md: Two planes make at most $4$ pieces, so $3$ cuts is the minimum; $2$ vertical $+\,1$ horizontal gives $2^3 = 8$.
